# Read tools for agents: list_runs, get_run_log, list_graphs

## What to build

Three new graph-manager MCP tools (KAN-91 #4, #6, #7) for agents in graph-manager terminals, plus the shared helpers the later run tools use. All live in `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/`, are written with `defineTool({ name, description, input, run })` (`tools/types.ts`) and are registered in `TOOLS` in `tools/index.ts`. They reach the agent through the existing `POST /api/internal/tools/:name` route (`routes/internal.ts:92-112`), which already resolves the calling terminal and its workspace into a `ToolContext` (`tc.workspace` is `undefined` when the terminal is outside every workspace). Every tool only sees the calling terminal's workspace. Results are plain text (Markdown tables / fenced blocks).

- `list_runs`: the runs of the workspace, newest first, with the workspace's Supervisor mode as the first line.
- `get_run_log`: the last N lines of `<workspace>/.graph-execution/<runId>/run.log`.
- `list_graphs`: the task folders under `.agents/tasks/` with their task counts and matching spec.
- New `tools/run-helpers.ts` (used by these and by the later tools `get_node_output`, `get_artifacts`, `cancel_run`, `resume_run`) and a test helper `tools/tool-test-helpers.ts`.

The dependency task (Supervisor setting) already delivered, in `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts`: `export type SupervisorMode = "report" | "act"` and `export function supervisorModeOf(data: Data, wsId: string): SupervisorMode` (returns `"report"` when unset), plus `GET/PUT /api/workspaces/:id/supervisor` with body `{ mode }` (PUT answers 204, behind the session cookie).

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/types.ts` (all, 35 lines) — `ToolContext`, `ToolResult`, `GmTool`, `defineTool`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/index.ts` (all) — the `TOOLS` registry to add to.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/open-start-run.ts` (all) — the one existing tool: input schema with `.describe()`, the workspace check, `resolveIn` path handling.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/open-start-run.test.ts` (lines 1-56) — how tool tests build the app (`buildApp(config, { internalToken })`), open a workspace terminal and a root terminal, and call `POST /api/internal/tools/:name`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.ts` (lines 92-112) — how a tool is called; a thrown error becomes `{ text: err.message, isError: true }`; invalid input becomes `invalid arguments: …`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` — `RunSummary` (lines 20-43), `isRunId` (106), `listWorkspaceRuns(ws, prs?, dataDir?)` (271-279; NOT sorted), `newestFirst` (266-268, not exported), `runDirOf(ws, runId)` (518), `readState` (163-170, private: copy its pattern).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` (lines 60-75) — how the Runs route calls `listWorkspaceRuns(ws, ctx.store.get().prs, ctx.config.dataDir)`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/inspect.ts` (lines 23-32: `countTaskFiles`) — counting task files of a folder (`*.json` directly in it, except `test-plan.json`). It is not exported yet.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/specs.ts` (lines 9-10) — `SPECS_DIR = "docs/prd"`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/test-helpers.ts` (all) — `tempDir`, `testConfig`, `cookieOf`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.test.ts` (lines 24-58) — a fake run folder: a `state.json` built with `stateSchema.parse({...})` from `graph-execution/api`.
- `docs/prd/agent-supervisor.md` — section "Requirements → Tools (KAN-91)", rows `list_runs`, `get_run_log`, `list_graphs`.

## Patterns to follow

**Tool shape** (`tools/open-start-run.ts:80-104`):
```ts
export const openStartRun = defineTool({
  name: "open_start_run",
  description: "Open graph-manager's Start run form for the user, …",
  input,
  async run(i, tc) {
    const ws = tc.workspace;
    if (!ws) return { isError: true, text: "this terminal is not inside a graph-manager workspace" };
    …
    return { text: `Opened the Start run form …` };
  },
});
```
Registration (`tools/index.ts:5`): `export const TOOLS: GmTool[] = [openStartRun as GmTool];` — each tool is cast `as GmTool`.

**Reading state.json tolerantly** (`runs.ts:163-170`):
```ts
async function readState(runDir: string): Promise<RunState | undefined> {
  try {
    const parsed = stateSchema.safeParse(JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(runDir, "state.json"), "utf8")));
    return parsed.success ? parsed.data : undefined;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}
```
`stateSchema` and `type RunState` come from `"graph-execution/api"`. `state.tasksDir` and `state.specPath` are absolute paths.

**Newest first** (`runs.ts:266-268`): `(b.createdAt ?? "").localeCompare(a.createdAt ?? "") || b.id.localeCompare(a.id)`.

**Test pattern** (`tools/open-start-run.test.ts:20-50`): `tempDir()`, `testConfig(t.dir)`, workspace at `<workspacesDir>/github/octo/hello` with a `.git` folder, `buildApp(config, { webDir: path.join(t.dir, "no-web"), viewCache: false, internalToken: TOKEN })`, login with `POST /api/auth/login { password: config.password }`, `POST /api/terminals { workspaceId: "github~octo~hello" }` (201, `{ id }`), a second terminal with payload `{}` (no workspace), then `POST /api/internal/tools/<name>` with `headers: { authorization: "Bearer t0ken" }` and payload `{ terminalId, cwd, input }`. Wrap the suite in `describe.skipIf(process.platform === "win32")`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/run-helpers.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  ```ts
  export const NOT_IN_WORKSPACE = "this terminal is not inside a graph-manager workspace";
  /** True for a ToolResult (has a string `text`), false for a Workspace or a string. */
  export function isToolResult(v: unknown): v is ToolResult;
  /** The calling terminal's workspace, or the error result. */
  export function requireWorkspace(tc: ToolContext): Workspace | ToolResult;
  /** `<ws>/.graph-execution/<runId>` when runId is a valid run id (isRunId) and that folder exists; else { isError: true, text: `unknown run ${runId}` }. */
  export async function runDirOrError(ws: Workspace, runId: string): Promise<string | ToolResult>;
  /** The last `lines` lines of a text file (trailing newline trimmed), or undefined when it is missing. Reads at most the last 4 MiB; when the read starts inside the file, the partial first line is dropped. */
  export async function readTailLines(file: string, lines: number): Promise<string | undefined>;
  /** `p` relative to the workspace with `/` separators ("." for the root); `p` unchanged when it is outside the workspace. */
  export function workspaceRel(ws: Workspace, p: string): string;
  /** Escapes a Markdown table cell: `|` → `\|`, newlines → spaces. */
  export function cell(s: string): string;
  /** A Markdown table from a header row and rows of cells (cells passed through `cell`). */
  export function table(head: string[], rows: string[][]): string;
  /** A fenced block that cannot be closed by the text inside (use a fence longer than any run of backticks in it, at least 3). */
  export function fenced(text: string): string;
  ```
- **PATTERN**: the readLogTail technique in `packages/graph-execution/src/agents/summarizer.ts:73-100` (open, stat, read from `size - N`, drop the partial first line when `start > 0`).
- **IMPORTS**: `existsSync`/`statSync` from `node:fs` (or `stat` from `node:fs/promises`), `open` from `node:fs/promises`, `path`, `isRunId, runDirOf` from `../runs.js`, `type Workspace` from `../workspaces.js`, `type ToolContext, type ToolResult` from `./types.js`.
- **GOTCHA**: `runDirOrError` must check `isRunId` BEFORE joining the path (an id like `../x` must never reach the filesystem), and the folder must be a directory. A run id of another workspace simply has no folder in this workspace → `unknown run <id>`. Usage pattern in tools:
  ```ts
  const ws = requireWorkspace(tc);
  if (isToolResult(ws)) return ws;
  const runDir = await runDirOrError(ws, i.runId);
  if (typeof runDir !== "string") return runDir;
  ```
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/tool-test-helpers.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** (test-only helper, not a `.test.ts` file; tasks after this one reuse it):
  ```ts
  export const TOKEN = "t0ken";
  export interface ToolApp {
    app: FastifyInstance; config: Config; cookie: string;
    wsDir: string;            // <workspacesDir>/github/octo/hello, a real `git init -q -b main` repo with one empty commit
    wsId: string;             // "github~octo~hello"
    terminalId: string;       // a terminal of the workspace
    rootTerminalId: string;   // a terminal outside every workspace (cwd = workspacesDir)
    call(name: string, input: unknown, opts?: { cwd?: string; terminalId?: string }): Promise<{ text: string; isError?: boolean }>;
    cleanup(): Promise<void>; // app.close() then remove the temp dir
  }
  export async function toolApp(overrides?: Partial<Config>): Promise<ToolApp>;
  /** Writes <wsDir>/.graph-execution/<runId>/state.json from a valid base state (stateSchema.parse) merged with `overrides`; returns the run folder. */
  export async function writeRun(wsDir: string, runId: string, overrides?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string>;
  ```
  `call` posts to `/api/internal/tools/<name>` with `Authorization: Bearer t0ken`, payload `{ terminalId, cwd, input }` (default cwd `wsDir`, default terminal `terminalId`), expects status 200 and returns the JSON. Base state for `writeRun` (from `runs.test.ts:28-43`): `{ runId, provider: "fake", startingCommit: "0".repeat(40), integrationBranch: `graph/${runId}`, specPath: path.join(wsDir, "spec.md"), tasksDir: path.join(wsDir, ".agents/tasks/demo"), hashes: { config: "", tasks: "", spec: "" }, tasks: { "1": { status: "merged", attempts: 1 }, "2": { status: "failed", attempts: 2 } }, review: { phase: "validate", round: 0, validationRounds: 0, reports: {} }, createdAt: "2026-11-06T10:00:00.000Z", status: "failed" }`.
- **PATTERN**: `tools/open-start-run.test.ts:20-44`; git commands as in `runs.test.ts:18-22,49-50` (`git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.com commit -q --allow-empty -m init`).
- **IMPORTS**: `execa` from `execa`, `stateSchema` from `graph-execution/api`, `buildApp` from `../app.js`, `cookieOf, tempDir, testConfig` from `../test-helpers.js`, `type Config` from `../config.js`.
- **GOTCHA**: use valid run ids in tests (`gm-20261106-100000-aaaa`; the pattern is `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`). Without a `lock` file and `web.json`, a run whose state says `running` is listed as `interrupted`; `failed`/`aborted`/`applied`/`done` come straight from `state.json`.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/list-runs.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `export const listRunsTool = defineTool({ name: "list_runs", … })`, input
  ```ts
  z.object({
    status: z.enum(["running", "failed", "applied", "done", "aborted", "interrupted"]).optional().describe("Only runs with this status"),
    limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(100).optional().describe("How many runs, newest first (default 20)"),
  })
  ```
  Description e.g. "List the graph-execution runs of this workspace, newest first, with their status, failure and task progress. The first line is the workspace's Supervisor mode: what to do when a run fails."
  Run: `requireWorkspace`; `const runs = (await listWorkspaceRuns(ws, tc.ctx.store.get().prs, tc.ctx.config.dataDir)).sort(newestFirst)`; filter by `status`; take `limit ?? 20`. Output lines:
  1. `Supervisor: report` or `Supervisor: act` (from `supervisorModeOf(tc.ctx.store.get(), ws.id)`).
  2. empty line, then either `No runs in this workspace.` (no run at all, or none matching: `No runs with status <s> in this workspace.`) or a table with the columns `run | status | failure | tasks | started | tasksDir`:
     - `failure`: `summary.failure ?? ""`.
     - `tasks`: from `summary.taskCounts`: `${merged}/${total} merged`, plus `, ${failed} failed` when failed > 0; `""` for a suite or no counts.
     - `started`: `summary.createdAt ?? ""`.
     - `tasksDir`: read `state.json` of runs (not suites) and show `workspaceRel(ws, state.tasksDir)`; `""` when unreadable.
  When more runs matched than were shown, end with `(N more; pass limit to see them)`.
- **PATTERN**: `routes/runs.ts:69-72` for the `listWorkspaceRuns` call.
- **IMPORTS**: `listWorkspaceRuns, runDirOf, type RunSummary` from `../runs.js`; `supervisorModeOf` from `../store.js`; helpers from `./run-helpers.js`.
- **GOTCHA**: `listWorkspaceRuns` is not sorted; sort newest first yourself (copy `newestFirst` or export it from `runs.ts`). Suites (`summary.type === "suite"`) are listed too (no tasks/tasksDir).
- **VALIDATE**: `cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/tools/list-runs.test.ts`

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/get-run-log.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `export const getRunLogTool = defineTool({ name: "get_run_log", … })`, input `z.object({ runId: z.string().min(1).describe("The run id, e.g. gm-20261106-100000-abcd"), lines: z.number().int().min(1).max(2000).optional().describe("How many lines from the end (default 200)") })`. Run: workspace + `runDirOrError`; `readTailLines(path.join(runDir, "run.log"), n)`; missing → `{ isError: true, text: `run ${runId} has no run.log yet` }`. Success text: `run.log of ${runId} (last ${n} lines)` + "\n\n" + `fenced(tail)`, where `n` is the requested count (default 200). When the file has fewer lines, say `(all ${count} lines)` instead.
- **GOTCHA**: "exactly the last N lines": a file ending with `\n` must not yield an empty last line (trim the trailing newline before splitting).
- **VALIDATE**: `cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/tools/get-run-log.test.ts`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/inspect.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `export` the existing `countTaskFiles(dir)` (lines 23-32; it returns `undefined` when not a folder). No behaviour change.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/list-graphs.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `export const listGraphsTool = defineTool({ name: "list_graphs", input: z.object({}), … })`. Walk `<ws>/.agents/tasks` (the folder itself included) recursively with `readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true })`, following only real directories (skip `isSymbolicLink()` entries), depth at most 8, at most 500 folders visited. A folder is listed when `countTaskFiles(folder) > 0`. For each: `tasksDir` = workspace-relative path with `/` (e.g. `.agents/tasks/agent-supervisor`), `tasks` = the count, `spec` = `docs/prd/<name>.md` if it is a file, else `docs/prd/done/<name>.md` if it is a file, else `""`, where `<name>` is the folder's basename. Sort by `tasksDir`. Output: table `tasksDir | tasks | spec`; when there are none: `No task folders in this workspace (none under .agents/tasks/).`
- **IMPORTS**: `readdir, stat` from `node:fs/promises`, `countTaskFiles` from `../routes/inspect.js`, `SPECS_DIR` from `../routes/specs.js`.
- **GOTCHA**: `.agents/tasks` may be missing (ENOENT) → the "none" text, not an error. Use `insideWorkspace(ws, ".agents/tasks")` from `../routes/runs.js` so a symlinked `.agents` pointing outside the workspace is not followed.
- **VALIDATE**: `cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/tools/list-graphs.test.ts`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/index.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `export const TOOLS: GmTool[] = [openStartRun as GmTool, listRunsTool as GmTool, getRunLogTool as GmTool, listGraphsTool as GmTool];` (later tasks add more; keep one tool per line if that reads better).
- **VALIDATE**: `cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/tools/index.test.ts`

### CREATE tests `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/list-runs.test.ts`, `get-run-log.test.ts`, `list-graphs.test.ts`

Use `toolApp()` / `writeRun()` from `./tool-test-helpers.js` in `beforeEach`/`afterEach`, inside `describe.skipIf(process.platform === "win32")`.
- list_runs:
  - `GET /api/internal/tools` (with the token) lists `list_runs`, `get_run_log`, `list_graphs`.
  - empty workspace → text `Supervisor: report\n\nNo runs in this workspace.`
  - a failed run (`writeRun(wsDir, id, { status: "failed" })`, task 2 failed) → first line `Supervisor: report`, a row with `failed`, `task 2 failed`, `1/2 merged, 1 failed`, `.agents/tasks/demo`.
  - `PUT /api/workspaces/github~octo~hello/supervisor { mode: "act" }` with the cookie → first line `Supervisor: act`.
  - two runs with different `createdAt` → newest row first; `{ status: "applied" }` filter shows only the applied one; `{ limit: 1 }` shows one row and `(1 more; …)`.
  - from `rootTerminalId` with cwd `config.workspacesDir` → `{ isError: true, text: "this terminal is not inside a graph-manager workspace" }`.
- get_run_log:
  - a `run.log` of 10 lines (`line1`…`line10\n`) and `{ runId, lines: 5 }` → the fenced block holds exactly `line6`…`line10`; header `run.log of <id> (last 5 lines)`.
  - no run.log → `run <id> has no run.log yet` (isError).
  - `{ runId: "nope-run" }` and `{ runId: "../x" }` → `unknown run nope-run` / `unknown run ../x`.
  - outside workspace → the workspace error.
- list_graphs:
  - folders `.agents/tasks/a` (2 task files + `test-plan.json`), `.agents/tasks/group/b` (1 task file), `.agents/tasks/empty` (no json) and `docs/prd/a.md`, `docs/prd/done/b.md` → rows `.agents/tasks/a | 2 | docs/prd/a.md` and `.agents/tasks/group/b | 1 | docs/prd/done/b.md`; `empty` is not listed.
  - no `.agents/tasks` → the "No task folders" text.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /api/internal/tools` lists `list_runs`, `get_run_log`, `list_graphs` with object input schemas; `tools/index.test.ts` still passes.
- [ ] Each of the three tools called from a terminal outside a workspace returns `{ isError: true, text: "this terminal is not inside a graph-manager workspace" }`.
- [ ] `list_runs` on a workspace with a failed run shows a row with status `failed` and its failure (`task 2 failed`), and the first line `Supervisor: report` (`Supervisor: act` after `PUT …/supervisor { mode: "act" }`).
- [ ] `get_run_log { runId, lines: 5 }` returns exactly the last 5 lines of `run.log`; a bad or foreign run id returns `unknown run <id>`; a missing log returns `run <id> has no run.log yet`.
- [ ] `list_graphs` lists `.agents/tasks/<name>` folders (recursively) with task counts and the matching spec from `docs/prd/` or `docs/prd/done/`.
- [ ] `run-helpers.ts` exports `requireWorkspace`, `runDirOrError`, `isToolResult` (and the small helpers above) for later tools.
- [ ] Tests pass: `cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/tools`

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/tools src/server/routes/internal-tools.test.ts src/server/routes/inspect.test.ts
```
